objective: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

description: Anything taken to an extreme is hazardous to our world, <name>. Take for example, the Scarlet Crusade. Do you believe that their blind zealotry serves a greater good? How many innocents have they destroyed in the name of the Light?

One in particular interests me, though; the Archivist Galford of Stratholme: A man that watches over the Crusade's most valued documents. Destroy him and burn down his archives! Should you succeed, return to me and be rewarded.
progress: Remember, <name> - we must be tolerant yet rigid in our beliefs!
completion: Outstanding, <name>! Years of intelligence, lost! The Scarlet Crusade will surely feel this blow in the coming weeks.
